objective: Find minimal countermodels separating projected image, context, exclusion history, and residue.
matched_tests: same image, same context, different history -> compare residue
same image, different context, same history -> compare admissibility
same distinction measure, different partition -> test residue determinacy
same source, alternate projection path -> test path dependence
undefined projection boundary -> classify collapse versus ordinary residue
falsification_targets: history-augmented law fails under matched image/context/history
stopping_rule: Stop after all factor cells have one negative-control, one positive-control, and one boundary case or are explicitly blocked by missing formal types.
